text:
Nina (Finance): Flagging an incident: three finalized invoices for Feb were generated twice for the same customer numbers. We have invoice_number collisions and one customer reported duplicate charge.

OpsBot: finalizer_job fj_2026_02_21 status=completed retries=1 warning=invoice_number_collision

Raj (Billing): Which customers? We need list + amounts to start refund flow.

Nina (Finance): Affected customers: PETAL-210, ZEN-44, ARROW-6. Each shows two invoice rows with same invoice_number but different internal line ids. Uploaded sample PDFs to secure share.

Devin (Engineering): Likely culprit: finalizer auto-retry when pdf-generation times out. The retry path is creating a new invoice row without checking for existing invoice_number for that customer.

Raj (Billing): Do we have payment_capture records for both invoice rows? If payments are duplicated we need to reverse immediately.

Nina (Finance): For PETAL-210 both invoice rows have payments; capture ids tx_775 and tx_776. Opened FIN-1678 to track refunds.

Devin (Engineering): Immediate mitigation: disable automatic finalizer retries. I'll flip the feature flag now. Longer fix: add a uniqueness guard that checks (customer_id, invoice_number) before creating, and attach retry metadata to the existing invoice if present. Also plan DB-level unique index with safe migration.

Raj (Billing): Please also export CSV of duplicate invoice ids and payment transaction ids for accounting. I'll coordinate with payments team for refunds.

Devin (Engineering): Actions: (1) disable retries (done 2026-03-03T10:02Z), (2) add application-level idempotency check PR opened #579, (3) write backfill to mark later duplicates voided with reason 'duplicate_finalizer_retry'. Will run staging tests then prod.

Nina (Finance): CS notified affected customers with interim message. Refund process started for PETAL-210. Will update FIN-1678 when refunds complete.

Raj (Billing): Please ensure we don't void the original if it has already been settled correctly. Void only the later-created duplicates.

Devin (Engineering): Noted. Backfill will compare created_at timestamps and void later rows, leaving earliest non-voided row intact. Also adding regression test simulating pdf-generation hang+retry.

Nina (Finance): Thanks. Closing loop when backfill + refunds done.
